headlines.snippet: The Iranian army claims to have attacked Patriot missile batteries in Kuwait and fuel storage facilities at a US base in Bahrain. The army stated it used kamikaze drones targeting these sites, along with an early warning system in Qatar.

headlines.title: בכיר אמריקני: "ההסלמה הנוכחית עם איראן עשויה להימשך כמה ימים ואף שבועות"

headlines.title: Photos: Israeli attacks kill nine people, including two children, in Gaza
headlines.snippet: Israeli air attacks and gunfire in Gaza resulted in the deaths of nine Palestinians, including two children, according to medics. These casualties occurred despite an existing ceasefire.
headlines.title_he: תמונות: התקפות ישראליות הרגו תשעה אנשים, כולל שני ילדים, בעזה

headlines.title: Son of Mexican national who was fatally shot by ICE speaks out
headlines.snippet: The son of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, a Mexican national fatally shot by ICE, has spoken out about the incident. The circumstances surrounding the shooting are under investigation.
headlines.title_he: בן של אזרח מקסיקני שנורה למוות על ידי ICE מדבר בקול

headlines.title: UK police arrest activists at Israeli-owned drone engine plant
headlines.snippet: UK police have arrested activists at a drone engine plant owned by an Israeli company. The arrests were made at the facility in connection with the ongoing protests.

headlines.title: ‘Double cross, first class’: Why India’s Modi wins so many foreign awards
headlines.snippet: Indian Prime Minister Modi has received numerous foreign awards, with the latest being presented during a visit to the Seychelles. This adds to his extensive collection of accolades.
headlines.title_he: 'בגידה כפולה, דרגה ראשונה': מדוע מודי מהודו זוכה בכל כך הרבה פרסים זרים

headlines.title: Iranian army says it targeted sites in Kuwait, Qatar and Bahrain
headlines.snippet: The Iranian army announced targeting sites in Kuwait, Qatar, and Bahrain using one-way attack drones. The targets included a Patriot missile system in Kuwait, an early warning system in Qatar, and fuel tanks in Bahrain.
headlines.title_he: הצבא האיראני אומר כי תקף אתרים בכווית, קטאר ובחריין
headlines.snippet_he: הצבא האיראני הודיע על פגיעה באתרים בכווית, קטאר ובחריין באמצעות רחפני תקיפה חד-כיווניים. המטרות כללו מערכת טילים פטריוט בכווית, מערכת התרעה מוקדמת בקטר, ומיכלי דלק בבחריין.

headlines.title: Morning update
headlines.snippet: Iran and the US are in a second day of intense exchanges, with a ceasefire reportedly collapsing. Tehran targeted US bases in Bahrain and Kuwait, while Washington struck approximately 90 targets across Iran. The Iranian Health Ministry reported 14 deaths and 78 injuries from US attacks.

headlines.title: Iran's Tehran-Mashhad railway suspended after US strikes
headlines.snippet: State media in Iran reported that train services between Tehran and Mashhad have been suspended following US strikes. This occurred just hours before the burial of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

headlines.title: US strikes across five Iranian provinces killed at least 14 people on Wednesday
headlines.snippet: US attacks across five Iranian provinces on Wednesday resulted in at least 14 deaths and 78 injuries, according to the Iranian Health Ministry. The strikes targeted various locations within the country.
headlines.title_he: תקיפות אמריקאיות בחמישה מחוזות איראניים הרגו לפחות 14 בני אדם ביום רביעי

headlines.title: US attacks kill three in Iran, state media says
headlines.snippet: State media reported that US strikes west of Iran killed at least three people and wounded several others. The attack reportedly took place on the outskirts of the city of Ahvaz.
